Because of the `--nobuild` and `--noprepare` flags, `package()` is never executed during this step. Even if it were, the decoded script is a standard local launcher that connects to the application's own localhost port (`127.0.0.1`) to check if the server is already running before opening the browser, which is expected application behavior.
</details>
